# ANALYSIS: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE walk-forward stability

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** walk-forward stability evaluation  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are evaluating the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate for walk-forward stability across 2025 Q3 to 2026 Q2. The hypothesis is that the OOS exp/tr monotonicity (increasing expectancy with DTE) holds in each quarter and that there is no regime where the edge deteriorates significantly.

## Mechanism

The candidate uses the same directional signal (vwap_continuation) at ITM-2 strike, with exits at -8% stop and +30% target, but varies DTE: 0DTE, 1DTE, 2DTE (weekly). We examine the OOS expectancy per trade for each DTE in each quarter from 2025 Q3 to 2026 Q2.
